name: Project Context page, both tabs, the budget projection's drop marking, the Agent Editor's read-only Context tab, and the run trace's project-context block
description: S18 of docs/plans/project-context.md. The seeded demo repo's `clone_path` points at a committed fixture clone (server/test/fixtures/context-clone) rather than a real git clone, so discovery has something to walk. `/context` renders the discovered documents — `docs/a.md` (leading-segment match), `server/docs/intent-layer.md` (NON-leading-segment match, D-2a — the case a prefix rule would miss), and `.devdigest/specs/prd.md` (the `.devdigest/specs/` prefix predicate, AC-4); the two committable negatives (root `README.md`, `src/notes.md`) are never asserted present, by construction. The Agents tab (default) is exercised against the seeded Security Reviewer, which has two real attachments (S18 seed): `server/docs/intent-layer.md` (fits the 8,000-token project-context budget — 'Injected') and a deliberately oversized `docs/large-notes.md` (~9,100 tokens on its own — 'Dropped (over budget)'), so the projection's drop marking is asserted against a real computed outcome, not a mocked one. The Skills tab is exercised too, in its correct empty state — this seed adds no skills. The Agent Editor's read-only Context tab (BQ-2/b) is then confirmed to render the SAME projection via the SAME `ProjectionSummary` component. Finally, PR #482's seeded Security Reviewer run — which now carries a real `run_traces` row (S18 seed, built by calling the actual `assembleProjectContext`/`specsReadFor` against the same fixture) — is opened in the trace drawer to confirm 'Specs read' lists both attachments with their real outcome strings and the 'Project context (dynamic)' prompt block expands to the actual injected text (AC-24's e2e half). The flow never presses Toggle on any document row (that would attach/detach for real) and never triggers a review run — no POST is made anywhere in this flow — which is how AC-14/AC-24 are satisfied without a model call, the same structural guarantee flow `09` uses for AC-34. Read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
